title: Collapse legacy toggle backplane and compact rollout archives
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Background: Over the last three years we accumulated a secondary compatibility path (the 'toggle backplane') that mirrors flag state between the canonical registry and legacy admin endpoints. This adapter was introduced to support slow-migrating customers and an A/B rollout experiment; it increases write amplification, complicates rollout history, and prevents TTL-based garbage collection of old rollout artifacts. Goals: 1) Remove the compatibility backplane and force reads/writes to the canonical flag registry. 2) Compact historical rollout artifacts into a canonical timeline format and purge redundant entries older than 90 days. 3) Provide a reversible migration that preserves active rollouts and keeps runtime safe during transition. Proposed approach: - Freeze writes to legacy admin endpoints for a 48-hour migration window (coordination with Platform SRE and Customer Success). - Run a two-phase migration: a) snapshot current rollout state from both registry and backplane, b) compact into canonical timeline using deterministic conflict resolution rules (last authoritative update wins, track source via metadata). - Deploy a short-lived compatibility shim in read-only mode to redirect any remaining legacy reads to the registry for 7 days. - Add canary migration on a low-traffic shard (shard-7) with synthetic traffic and monitoring before cluster-wide migration. - Implement database GC job to purge orphaned artifacts older than 90 days after compaction. Safety & rollback: - Preflight checks ensure no active canary rollouts have unresolved deltas. - Migration is reversible for 72 hours by restoring the pre-migration snapshot. - If errors are detected, automatic circuit breaker re-enables the backplane in passthrough mode for impacted customers. Tests & validation: - Unit tests for compaction logic and conflict resolution. - Integration test that simulates concurrent toggle writes across both paths. - End-to-end test: create, update, rollback a rollout and validate KV cache and runtime behavior. Observability: - Temporary dashboards: rollout-consistency, backplane-write-rate, compaction-errors. - Alerting: compaction-failure (P0), unexpected-delta-count (P1), migration-latency (P2). Deliverables: - Migration script (db-migrate/compact-rollouts.sql + service-side compaction job). - Canary deployment plan and runbook (linked below). - Docs update for decommissioned endpoints and admin guidance. Stakeholders: Platform SRE, Console, Customer Success, Security (for audit log retention). Timeline: canary start 2025-02-10, cluster migration 2025-02-17, GC job 2025-03-10. Links: Confluence migration spec: https://confluence.company.internal/config-convergence/compact-rollouts, Runbook draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-example, Slack channel: #eng-config-migrations
